settings.heading: I've used creams for years. Why would a capsule help?
settings.content: Creams work on the surface for a few hours. The swelling starts underneath, in the cushions of tissue and the veins that support them. This formula is designed to support that tissue from the inside, every day, so you're not relying on the next tube.*

settings.heading: How long until I notice something?
settings.content: Most people use it daily for at least 8 to 12 weeks, because collagen and vein support build up over time. That's why the 3- and 5-month bundles are the most popular.

settings.heading: I had hemorrhoids after pregnancy. Is this for me?
settings.content: Postpartum flare-ups are one of the most common reasons people come to us. If you're pregnant or nursing, check with your doctor before starting any supplement.

settings.heading: Can I take it with fiber or stool softeners?
settings.content: Yes. Fiber keeps things moving; this supports the tissue itself. Many customers use both. If you take prescription medication, especially blood thinners, ask your doctor first.

settings.heading: When should I see a doctor instead?
settings.content: Always see a doctor for rectal bleeding, severe pain, a lump that won't go back in, or any change in your bowel habits. This is a daily supplement, not a replacement for medical care.

settings.heading: Is the packaging discreet?
settings.content: Yes. Every order ships in plain packaging with no product name on the outside.

settings.heading: Is there a guarantee?
settings.content: Yes, a full 90-day money-back guarantee. If it doesn't work for you, we'll refund you in full.
